purpose: Separate recorded charging facts from unsupported meter, loss, tariff and billing assumptions.
primaryGoal: Inspect session reconciliation and its supporting evidence; export canonical values without inferring unsupported readings.

method.scope: Accepted mounted page, its directly used feature panels/formatters/export adapter, and read-only immediate hook/type/route/backend/formatting/table/catalog contracts.
method.sourceDerivedReproductions: All reproductions below are paper traces of inspected source, not executed tests, fixtures, requests or mounted interactions.

dataSources.contract: Positive selected vehicle; query key includes vehicle, limit and offset; queryFn forwards AbortSignal to request; list hook returns raw SI.
dataSources.agreement: SOURCE_MATCH: MountRoutes registers GET /charging-forensics under /advanced-intelligence in the shared API composition root. vehicle_id/limit/offset are snake_case; handler permits limit 1..100 and offset 0..100000.

dataSources.endpoint: Same GET with limit=100 and incrementing offset

dataSources.currentCapabilities: Current service returns vehicle energy, recorded cost/currency, started/ended times, evidence and limitations. Meter energy, loss/bounds, expected cost and discrepancy remain null. Current statuses are unsupported, incomplete and recorded_only; quality is insufficient or limited. Supported non-null meter/loss/billing cases in existing mocked tests are not proof of current backend capability.
dataSources.wireAgreement: Go nullable fields and snake_case names match ChargingForensicsItem; Wh remains canonical energy.

MobileDataTablePresentation: summary roles plus session-associated allDetails
EvidencePanel: data quality, sources and limitations

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026: unresolved and failed sources are not authoritatively unsupported or empty
confirmedIssues.mechanism: EvidencePanel always mounts an InsightPanel without query/sourceState/error. Absent quality/evidence/limitations immediately select definitive 'Quality metadata is unsupported', 'No supporting evidence was returned' and 'No additional limitations were returned' copy. The page supplies only payload-derived props, so initial loading, paused-first-load and fatal-first-load all use this ready-looking empty disclosure. The reconciliation neighbor handles the query correctly but does not change these assertions.
confirmedIssues.sourceDerivedRepro: Trace vehicleId=4 with query.data undefined and isLoading=true/fetchStatus=fetching, or a first-load error. items becomes []; page lines 222-225 pass undefined quality and empty flattened arrays. EvidencePanel lines 40-46 supply no query; its empty-array branches render the three assertions before any successful response.
confirmedIssues.expected: Keep the evidence shell and static unsupported capability notice visible, but distinguish not-yet-resolved/paused/failed evidence from a successful empty response; retain previously returned disclosure on refresh failure.
confirmedIssues.fix: Compose the existing source-state/query presentation into this panel without adding a second trust model or hiding the whole page.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-044: preserve selected locale and timezone consistently
confirmedIssues.mechanism: EvidencePanel imports the unbound lib formatDateTime and passes no locale/timezone options. That formatter explicitly defaults to browser locale/timezone. The page's Started, mobile Ended and mobile evidence dates instead use useDateFormat, which resolves settings locale and selected timezone. Identical evidence instants can therefore show different dates/times between the page's mobile session detail and its evidence section.
confirmedIssues.sourceDerivedRepro: For observed_at=2026-06-01T12:30:00Z, user/vehicle display timezone Pacific/Auckland and browser timezone UTC, the page hook represents June 2 00:30 while EvidencePanel's unbound formatter represents June 1 12:30. No actual browser timezone or identity was read.
confirmedIssues.expected: Use the same existing date preferences for observation window, evidence timestamps and session timestamps.
confirmedIssues.fix: Use useDateFormat or an existing explicit formatter-preferences prop; do not change UTC wire/export values.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-023/MDC-043: preserve all original record fields and meaningful details across table presentations
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Ended time, separate currency code and session-associated evidence/limitations are exclusively supplied through mobilePresentation.allDetails. The desktop columns contain only the nine reconciliation fields and the page does not opt into expandable/renderExpanded or a row-detail action. Desktop EvidencePanel flattens evidence/limitations from all sessions without preserving session_id. Consequently desktop cannot access Ended or reliably associate repeated evidence/limitations with their source session.
confirmedIssues.sourceDerivedRepro: Trace two rows with different session_id/ended_at and identical source='charging_sessions'. In allocated desktop table mode, allDetails is not rendered; DataTable's expansion defaults false. The global evidence cards receive identical flattened source/summary records, not their session IDs. Switching to mobile detail recovers the associated fields, demonstrating presentation asymmetry rather than absent API data.
confirmedIssues.expected: A desktop-accessible existing row-details/expansion path should expose the same session-associated fields available on mobile.
confirmedIssues.fix: Reuse DataTable's existing row-detail/expansion capabilities and the same record-detail renderer; preserve the mobile adapter and all nine columns.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-045/046 and original-schema export declaration: source-record and disclosure preservation
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The adapter's explicit object omits ended_at, evidence and limitations even though they are returned by the current backend and exposed in mobile details. It also changes nullable meter/loss/cost/currency values into empty strings, including in JSON. The comment promises the original SI/minor-unit schema and the download description promises the full reconciliation result; actual serialized records are a lossy projection, not that original record.
confirmedIssues.sourceDerivedRepro: Paper-trace a row with ended_at, evidence=[{source:'charging_sessions',...}], limitations=['Meter-side energy ... not recorded'], and meter_energy_wh=null through chargingForensicsExportRow. The output has no ended_at/evidence/limitations and meter_energy_wh=''. The page maps both CSV and JSON through this same adapter before serialization.
confirmedIssues.expected: Preserve session endpoint/disclosures and JSON null semantics, or explicitly and accurately declare a narrower numeric-ledger export rather than claiming original/full reconciliation records.
confirmedIssues.fix: Keep canonical SI/minor-unit values and include record/disclosure fields; use CSV-appropriate serialization separately from typed JSON null handling.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-023: loaded/partial exports must not be represented as full results
confirmedIssues.mechanism: fetchAllChargingForensics stops when offset reaches 10000 and returns accumulated rows without an incomplete-result signal or exception. The page unconditionally downloads those rows as the full reconciliation result. Current repository count is not capped at 10000 and the handler permits offsets beyond it.
confirmedIssues.sourceDerivedRepro: Assume a valid stable total=10001 and 100 items for offsets 0 through 9900. After 100 reads, rows.length=10000; the inner break remains false because 10000<10001. The loop condition rejects offset=10000 and return rows succeeds. Session 10001 is silently absent. This is a paper trace only; no requests or large fixtures were created.
confirmedIssues.expected: Retain the safety bound but explicitly refuse or label an incomplete export, or continue within a safely supported complete-export strategy.
confirmedIssues.owner: integration/API hook owner; page export caller
confirmedIssues.fix: Expose completion/limit-reached evidence and prevent a partial packet from being advertised as full.

confirmedIssues.rule: Wire/display currency denomination agreement; do not guess currency units
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The immediate repository contract generates recorded_cost_minor using ROUND(cost_decimal * 100) irrespective of cost_currency. The page formatter interprets recorded_cost_minor using the currency's Intl fraction-digit exponent, not an unconditional /100. These two assumptions agree for USD-style two-digit currencies but disagree for zero- and three-digit currencies. This is an end-to-end contract mismatch, not a request to change the otherwise currency-aware frontend formatter to a fixed /100.
confirmedIssues.sourceDerivedRepro: For a source amount cost_decimal=100 and cost_currency='JPY', repository arithmetic produces recorded_cost_minor=10000. Intl JPY digits=0 makes the page formatter divide by 1 and display JPY 10000. For a three-digit currency the same repository multiply-100 is then divided by 1000. No claim is made that such a row currently exists or that real ingestion was exercised.
confirmedIssues.expected: Define and consistently produce true ISO-currency minor units at the wire boundary, or explicitly constrain supported currencies without silently rescaling recorded amounts.
confirmedIssues.fix: Resolve the existing denomination contract at its source; preserve negative/zero amounts, recorded currency and no-conversion policy.
confirmedIssues.confidence: high-source conditional on a returned non-two-digit currency; actual currency population unverified

confirmedIssues.rule: I18N_GUIDELINES rule 5: pluralization via count-aware forms
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The sampleLine key and both source fallbacks are '{{count}} samples · {{date}}' with no singular/plural sibling forms. Current backend evidence supplies sample_count=1, so source-derived output is '1 samples'. The existing mocked page test also expects that text; it was only read, not run.
confirmedIssues.sourceDerivedRepro: Use the current service's intPointer(1) evidence count. Both evidence presentation paths pass count=1 into the single plain catalog key and render the plural noun unchanged.
confirmedIssues.expected: One sample versus multiple samples through the existing i18next plural catalog mechanism.
confirmedIssues.owner: assigned catalog/localization owner; page/feature fallback owner if needed
confirmedIssues.fix: Add the appropriate singular/plural forms at the existing catalog owner, without changing technical identifiers or API enum values.

candidates.concern: Small nonzero energy/loss/bounds can round to the same display value under low user precision.
candidates.disposition: REVIEW, not a confirmed fabricated-zero defect. useUnits intentionally honors decimal_precision and preserves signs/raw SI. Current backend loss/bounds are null; extreme supported-loss cases are hypothetical. Specialist forensic precision policy needs a design decision, not an invented preference override.

candidates.concern: The date-bearing list is all-time and has no workspace range consumption.
candidates.disposition: NOT A CONFIRMED IGNORED-RANGE BUG. Current RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS excludes /intelligence/charging-forensics and the immediate handler/repository expose only vehicle/limit/offset, with no date bounds. Vehicle is header-owned and enabled. If time-scoped forensics is required later, it needs an explicit integration assignment for both bounds, full aggregates and exports; do not add a duplicate local date picker.

candidates.concern: Raw technical status labels and backend English evidence/reasons are not locale-adapted.
candidates.disposition: NOT CLASSIFIED AS A CONFIRMED MISSING-KEY DEFECT. I18N_GUIDELINES rule 7 explicitly preserves technical/FSM/database identifiers; table guidelines also prohibit recasing source data. Page-owned labels use t() and the inspected forensics catalog contains their keys. Any human-readable enum/structured backend-message localization must preserve original source values and be separately designed.

candidates.concern: Unrecognized runtime quality status would fall through to danger.
candidates.disposition: ROBUSTNESS CANDIDATE ONLY. Current TypeScript union and current service return recognized statuses. No invalid response was supplied or observed; do not claim present failure or change valid insufficient semantics without owner review.

states.notSelected: Page passes undefined query to reconciliation; vehicle-selection empty copy is explicit. No table/pagination action is mounted for empty content.
states.initialLoading: Reconciliation resolves loading through existing SourceContent; evidence shell stays present but CF-01 applies.
states.initialPausedOrUnresolved: InsightPanel differentiates unresolved/paused availability from resolved empty reconciliation; CF-01 applies to evidence disclosure.
states.initialError: Reconciliation exposes fatal error/retry without hiding alert or evidence section; CF-01 applies to evidence disclosure.
states.resolvedEmpty: Reconciliation has explicit empty copy. Quality metadata may remain visible. No record means no fabricated energy/cost.
states.success: Nine reconciliation columns; quality, evidence, limitations and explicit unsupported capability list remain mounted.
states.retainedRefreshFailureOrPause: InsightPanel uses hasData/stale status to keep children, source freshness and nonblocking refresh failure/paused warning with individual retry. Evidence receives retained query.data; its own panel has no separate trust-state props.
states.pageRecovery: Successful non-placeholder response with matching offset and safe nonnegative total clamps invalid pages. A failed/placeholder response does not trigger this correction. Selected vehicle changes reset page synchronously.
states.partialFields: Energy formatter maps null/nonfinite to em dash; unsupported meter/loss/cost uses explicit translated label; interval endpoints independently tolerate null. Zero and signed energy/cost remain eligible for formatting.

numericAndDateReview.SI: Source-confirmed: raw vehicle/meter/loss fields are Wh; useUnits performs display-boundary conversion and respects locale/decimal_precision. No legacy converter caller was found in inspected direct files.
numericAndDateReview.displayPrecision: Energy follows user precision; currency uses its denomination fraction digits. Forensic low-precision concern is C-01; currency source agreement is CF-06.
numericAndDateReview.signs: No positivity or truthiness guard drops valid zero/negative energy, loss or discrepancy. Null cost/currency is distinct from zero. No fresh numeric tests were run.
numericAndDateReview.dates: Session dates and mobile evidence use useDateFormat; global evidence has CF-02. UTC timestamps remain original in the export fields that are retained.
numericAndDateReview.workspace: Selected vehicle is the workspace owner; there is no duplicate VehicleSelect/RangePicker. Route has vehicle=true and range=false by inspected workspaceScope source.
numericAndDateReview.currency: No currency conversion inferred. Missing currency is unsupported; formatter accepts ISO denomination semantics, but the backend recorded-cost source has CF-06.
